title: EvolutionTech
description: This project adds energy, generators, machines like electric furnace, extractor and pipes with filter slots, tin ore generation, bronze ingot, bronze tools and armor.
body:
**EvolutionTech: Ages** is a technology progression mod inspired by my favourite mods, IndustrialCraft and BuildCraft using NeoForge.

Start in primitive ages and evolve through steam, electrical and advanced technologies, unlocking machines, power systems and automation as you progress. There are pipes with filters in order to order items.

## Machines
- **Energy Generator**: Generate energy burning combustible items
- **Electric Furnace**: Smelt items using produced energy transferred by cables
- **Extractor**: Extract resin from resinwood and rubber from resin. Also, Biofuel Cell from Bio Cell
- **Macerator**: Crush ores into dust and get double amount of ingots
- **Energy Storage**: Store up to 100.000 EU

## Resinwood Tree
- This new tree type will be generated in forest biome.

## New Ore Type: Tin
- This new ore type will be generated between Y:-64 and Y:80 in veins of 9 (max).

## Bronze Age
- Craft bronze dust from copper and tin dusts, smelt it to get bronze ingots.
- Craft bronze tools
- Craft bronze weapons
